name: Shirei no Koi
source:
Mior, a rookie priest assigned to a desolate village, encounters a mysterious boy named Faye deep in the forest.

White hair, red eyes. Smiling in solitude, he felt cold to the touch yet terrifyingly captivating.

Though his duty demanded he keep his distance, Mior found himself irresistibly drawn to Fei with each encounter.

A decaying mansion, an everlasting rose, and Fei's hidden secret—

All led Mior deeper into a forbidden love.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4238300/_Wraiths_Embrace/]Steam[/url]]
